credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Georgia O'Keeffe sitting in a raft alongside another raft with Tish Frank, Kathy Porter and Doris Bry. Both rafts are full of camping supplies. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Tish Frank, Kathy Porter, Doris Bry in Rafts
